lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: 2 minutes left!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hurry, hurry, hurry!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Rushing me won't make it go faster!
Are you done with all the backups?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yep, down to the last bit. Once Lily is finished, we're good to go.
*Krrrrrshhh*
Water pours in through the cracks in the walls and ceiling.
The water is already up to our ankles.
At this rate, it won't be much longer until the entire bunker is underwater.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Elegg! The water is coming this way!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Gah! Stay back! Shoo, shoo!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: ... Did you really think that would work?
Can't you go any faster?!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Don't pull it out right away! You need to eject it properly!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Ugh, damn this ancient machine!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: ... There, all done, for real this time!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Let's run!

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Gaaaahh!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Whew...! Whew...!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We got everything we needed. There's nothing missing.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: That was close.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: The bunker is submerged.
We stand atop a hill overlooking the city, staring nonplussed at the newly reformed lake.
After 100 long years, the waters have claimed the bunker,
dragging its long history along with it down to the aquatic depths.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I can't believe that place really lasted an entire century...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Where do you think all that water came from?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Beats me, but it has to have come from somewhere. Nowhere on the surface is normal.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Let's get going, Hermin.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: EVE.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I'm sorry everyone, but can you wait just a moment?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I'll be right back.
Huh?
*Splash*
Eve dives into the lake.
Inside the bunker, now completely submerged, everything is dark.
Despite this, EVE can make out a rough outline of what she's looking for.
The sudden rush of water has resulted in a fast current.
EVE is certain that she'll be swept away if she doesn't grab ahold of something.
She presses against the wall and focuses.
She finds what she's looking for.
Despite the rapid current, it's miraculously remained in the same place as before.
Eve pushes off the wall and darts through the water.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Why hasn't she come up yet?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Let's wait a little longer.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Why did she jump in there so suddenly anyway?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Probably...
*Splash*

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: EVE!

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Phew... I think this is... the first time I've been out of breath...!

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I almost got swept away by the current.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: What the heck are you doing?! What'd you do that for?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I had to find something.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Did you succeed?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yes. I have it here.
As EVE comes out of the lake,
she is holding tightly onto several picture frames.
She slowly walks over to Hermin and hands them to him.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Sorry that they got a bit wet.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: I... I can't believe it!

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: That data may contain humanity's past, but these photos are your past.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I assumed they meant a lot to you.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: These all remind me of precious memories.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Glad to hear I was correct.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: EVE.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why do you work so hard?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Excessively so,

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: based on my observations.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: You risk your life too often.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Do you want to die?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Working hard and putting yourself in danger are two different things.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why do you put yourself in harm's way so often?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I believe...

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: it's the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I don't understand.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: You and me both.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Me three.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I don't put my life at risk as often as you think.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: I know what I'm capable of, and so I proceed.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: I may not understand completely, but I have complete faith in you and your abilities.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uh, I hate to interrupt, but...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Does anyone else feel a vibration?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sure, but isn't that because of all the rushing water?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No... the ground is shaking.
Rapi quickly moves to higher ground.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We have to prepare for battle.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Large force of Raptures incoming.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I see more than three Tyrant-class entities.
Everyone, get ready for battle.
Privaty, protect Hermin.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Our left side is weak! Concentrate fire!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So is our right side.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And the center!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yikes, we're compromised on all sides! We need to raise the level of our firepower!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Why don't we move our defensive line back a bit?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't want to destroy this city.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Well, then we'll just have to dig deep and keep pushing!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We've got to hold the line as best as we can!
*Shooooo*
*Boom*
A massive steel figure lands in front of us, standing between us and the Raptures.
Its back is turned to us,
and the silhouette resembles that of a human.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: You're here!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Exosuit Providence, reporting for duty!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Is that Ms. Lily inside that thing?!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: That's right! Although I'm not sure how effective this will be against Raptures,

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: this exosuit isn't exactly a pushover, so I'm not too worried.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Are you sure we should be using it? That's an incredibly valuable piece of equipment.

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: We owe these guys a huge debt. Surely, this is the least we can do?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: You can't fool me. You just want to show off.

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Hehe, guilty as charged.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: ... Fine.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Let's show them.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Get out of there! Hurry!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I'll pilot it! I'll hold off the Raptures!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: No! It makes more sense for me to do it!
Everyone, stop bickering! I'm clearly the one who should be piloting it.

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: ... Sorry, but I'm not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Now let's go!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Everyone! Cover Lily!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Roger! With a giant war machine like this on our side, how can we possibly lose?

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Hyyyyaaah!
Providence deftly moves both on land and in the air, unleashing a merciless fusillade of various armaments.
A ceaseless barrage of explosions rings out, sending flames, light beams, and sparks flying every which way.
It's an incredible sight to behold.
And yet...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uh... it really does look spectacular, but none of its shots seem to be landing.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The accuracy does leave something to be desired...
*Boom*
A Rapture files a missile and scores a direct hit on Providence.

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Ungh!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Same goes for its ability to evade.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Lily...

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: J-just give me a second! I'm not used to this type of enemy is all!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: I've got it configured to combat Naytiba, that's why!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Er... let's see... what if I do this?

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: All right, I've set the target to Rap...
*Boom*
Another missile strikes Providence.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Lily! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: I think she passed out.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: That's it, I'm going in!

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Hold on.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: We've got this in the bag.
Providence starts moving again.
This time, it moves with utter precision as it unleashes an overwhelming barrage of firepower.
The only word to describe it is utter decimation.
The battlefield becomes clear in an instant.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: ... Amazing.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: When the attack target is set to Rapture, and the pilot is incapacitated, the automatic combat system is activated.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: So long as it's being operated properly, that program can handle this kind of opponent with ease.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... But Lily has no idea how to operate it.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Well, she at least knows how to turn it on or off.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mmm, turning something on or off is important.
Providence stands tall amidst the defeated Rapture horde,
scanning the surroundings for any survivors.
After finishing its scan, it turns and faces us.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Whoa, so cool!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Let's go and ask if we can take a ride in it!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: For sure!
*Click*
Providence pushes its weapon forward.
Is that a victory pose?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Wow! Whoever designed this really knows their stuff!
*Kreeeee*!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Is that just me, or does that sound like a weapon charging?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Everyone, prepare for battle!

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: How did...?!
